What does the CLI return when configuration loading, hashing, opening the database, schema creation, insertion or commit fails?

precedent.topic: Bootstrap failure outcomes and CLI exit codes

topics.topic: Module and capability responsible for expense section validation
questions: Does `expense_intake` validate sections directly through its transaction's repository, or call `budget_management.validate_project_section`, which it does not know according to State 3 and which would introduce a separate use-case transaction?
Which module and capability validate an initial expense allocation's section ownership?

Does `expense_intake` validate section ownership directly through its transaction repository, or must its declared module dependencies be changed so it can call `budget_management.validate_project_section`?

quotes:
Each of them resolves sections of the project itself,
through `module:portal_store`'s section repository (Factory code
`application/expense_intake.py`, `domain/expense_management.py`).

`capability:expense_intake.create_expense_from_recognition` accepts only a
confirmed complete result of a supported contract version, validates the
total and the explicit allocations — every section of the project
(`capability:budget_management.validate_project_section`), positive amounts,
exact sum, no proportional split — then in one transaction looks up the
`recognized_document_id`: absent — insert the expense, its allocations and
one client-visible document and append `expense.create`; same fingerprint —
return the existing expense as replay; different — conflict.
judgement.divergence: One implementation has `expense_intake` query its transaction's section repository directly; the other makes it call `budget_management.validate_project_section`, changing the module dependency and transaction call graph observed by the module dependency checker and capability author.
judgement.why: State 4 assigns the same validation both to `expense_intake` itself and to a capability owned by a module that `expense_intake` is not declared to know.
